parts.text: Best cold email tools for B2B SaaS in 2024: **Instantly.ai** for unlimited sending accounts and built-in warmup, **Smartlead.ai** for high-volume sending with master inbox, **Lemlist** for advanced personalization with liquid syntax, and **Apollo.io** for all-in-one contact data + sequencing. Instantly.ai leads on deliverability with 1000+ warmup pool. Smartlead.ai offers best price per email at scale. Apollo.io wins if you need contact database + outreach in one platform.
